content.text:
After 8 years it says "נשאר בידיים" "68,853". I put in "48,000". Then "החזר המס הוסיף" 9,581 and "התשואה הוסיפה" 11,272. And "המס לקח" 0. It's all "בכסף של היום", and "7%... הנחות של האתר, לא תחזית". After 4 years it only showed 25,725, with the orange note saying they don't calculate tax yet for the self-employed before 6 years. That's enough for me.

**What I'd tell my son:**
These numbers assume 500 ₪ a month, which was already filled in. Nobody gave me an amount, so I didn't change it. If I take the money out after 4 years, the page shows about 25,725 ₪. But an orange note says that for self-employed people it doesn't yet work out the tax for taking money out before 6 years ("לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים"), and that tax would be paid like on business income. So the real amount after 4 years would be less, and I don't know by how much. After 8 years it says about 68,853 ₪ "נשאר בידיים" (left in my hands), in today's money. I would have put in 48,000 of that. The rest is "החזר המס" (a tax refund, I think) of 9,581 and "התשואה" (the earnings) of 11,272, and no tax taken. It also says the 7% a year is the site's own assumption, "לא תחזית", not a forecast. I'm fairly sure about 8 years. For 4 years, the bank or the accountant would have to tell me the tax.

**How it went:**
- The page is dark, but the letters were big and I could read them.
- I pressed "מה קורה לכסף בקרן" and got straight to the calculator. Then I pressed "עצמאים", and the boxes jumped around. That annoyed me.
- I tapped the year numbers under the bars and didn't touch the slider.
- At 8 years there was a row of six numbers. I only understood them once I scrolled down and saw the words under each column.
- The first page says that at "גיל הפרישה" (retirement age) 3 years is enough to take the money out without tax. At 67 that may be me, but the calculator never asked my age.
- I didn't understand "במסלול מדד", "אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך" or "החזר המס".

input.answer: With the 500 ₪ a month that was already filled in, the calculator shows about 25,725 ₪ after 4 years, but it says it doesn't yet work out the tax for self-employed people taking money out before 6 years, so the real amount would be lower. After 8 years it shows about 68,853 ₪ left in hand, in today's money: 48,000 that I put in plus a tax refund and earnings, with no tax.
